feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 June 2026 11:55am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 17 June 2026 at 11:50am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight, occasionally 2 to 4 in Liverpool bay for a time overnight. Increasing 5 or 6 by late tomorrow morning, but 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building slight or moderate overnight, then mostly moderate by late morning tomorrow, but remaining slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Fair, then a band of heavy rain arriving after dawn in the west of the area, moving to the east by late morning.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but remaining slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Rain becoming patchier, before generally clearing. Mist and fog patches developing in the south of the area, gradually spreading to central and western areas.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, poor in heavy rain or mist. Very poor in fog patches.
